summary: Windows-first local RAG desktop app: WPF/WebView2 shell, in-process ASP.NET Minimal API backend, React/Vite web UI, SQLite plus sqlite-vec local storage, Ollama integration, OCR and Office ingestion support, and Inno Setup packaging.
active_objective: OnlyRag asset kit integration is complete across app icon, favicon/PWA, installer artwork, social metadata, README, docs, and asset inventory; signed release and clean-machine installer lifecycle verification remain separate release blockers.
assumptions: Existing uncommitted source and documentation changes predate this intake and must not be reverted.
Commands that install or update dependencies are documented but were not run during this intake unless already required by a checked script.
Generated outputs under bin, obj, dist, node_modules, and artifacts are not source state.
Inno Setup standard wizard pages are kept because the request forbids changing installer technology or introducing a new UI framework.

decisions.decision: Treat Windows plus PowerShell 7 as the primary development and release environment.
decisions.impact: Repository commands, path checks, installer verification, and release tasks are evaluated against Windows tooling first.

decisions.decision: Use npm as the frontend package manager because src/OnlyRag.Web/package-lock.json is present and package.json scripts are npm-based.
decisions.impact: Do not introduce pnpm, yarn, or alternate frontend package manager conventions.

decisions.decision: Do not promote installer artifacts as release artifacts until a trusted code-signing certificate, signtool, Inno Setup, and signed lifecycle verification are available.
decisions.impact: Packaging can be verified separately from release; signed release tasks remain blocked.

decisions.decision: Use an Inno Setup Pascal Script wrapper for prerequisite dialog lines instead of pixel-specific page fixes.
decisions.impact: Unsupported-Windows and missing-WebView2 dialogs share one wrapping behavior, preserving the existing installer technology while reducing clipping risk for long product names, paths, URLs, and localized wording.

decisions.decision: Preserve the existing OnlyRag Windows-first identity and extend the generated asset inventory instead of introducing a rebrand.
decisions.impact: The source app icon, favicon/PWA assets, GitHub README logo, social card images, and Inno Setup wizard artwork remain generated by scripts\Generate-BrandAssets.ps1 from the existing editable SVG and WPF drawing pipeline.

current_tasks.objective: Provide a trusted Windows code-signing certificate with private key outside Git.
acceptance_criteria: A trusted certificate is available as certificates/app/OnlyRag-CodeSigning.pfx or in Cert:\CurrentUser\My / Cert:\LocalMachine\My.
Certificate material and passwords remain outside Git.
The signing script can resolve the certificate without exposing secrets.

current_tasks.objective: Build, sign, timestamp, and verify the installer lifecycle on a clean Windows verification machine.
acceptance_criteria: Signed installer is produced under artifacts/installer.
scripts/Test-InstallerRelease.ps1 -RequireSigned -RunInstallLifecycle passes on a clean Windows machine.
SmartScreen behavior is recorded before public distribution.

next_tasks: Provide a trusted code-signing certificate outside Git.
Run the full repository gate with dependency restore on a clean checkout before release.
Run signed installer lifecycle verification on a clean Windows verification profile.
Add a repository license file before enabling an installer license acceptance page.
Run installer wizard visual verification at Windows DPI 125%, 150%, and 200% plus non-default UI font/accessibility text settings on a clean verification machine.

blockers.reason: No .pfx exists under certificates/app and no code-signing certificate was detected in CurrentUser or LocalMachine certificate stores. Inno Setup 6 and signtool.exe were found locally.

risks.description: The repository has many pre-existing modified and untracked files, including source, tests, web tooling, docs, and CI; follow-up work should avoid broad rewrites and review diffs carefully.
Fresh setup depends on .NET restore, npm ci, and optional OCR package preparation; network/package-source availability and local toolchain versions can affect first-run reliability.
Installer release signing cannot be completed until trusted certificate material is available; Inno Setup and signtool are available locally.
Install, launch, upgrade, rollback, uninstall, signature enforcement, and SmartScreen behavior were not executed during intake.
Inno Setup license acceptance is not configured because the repository has no LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING/NOTICE file to present.

Installer script and current-DPI first-page screenshot were verified locally, but full visual pass across DPI 125/150/200%, non-default fonts, and later wizard pages still requires an interactive Windows verification machine.

Ollama for chat, embeddings, and translation model features
Optional LibreOffice for legacy Office conversion and PDF export
Optional Python 3.10+ PaddleOCR runtime for OCR
development: ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript, and Vite from src\OnlyRag.Web
Windows SDK signtool.exe for signed release candidates
external_services: Ollama endpoint, local or explicitly trusted non-loopback
RFC 3161 timestamp server for release signing

configuration_sources: Persistent UI/backend settings are stored in SQLite settings rows: Ollama, performance, OCR, OCR processing, ingestion, and Office conversion.

Application defaults live in code: AppStoragePaths, OllamaEndpointOptions, OcrSettings, OcrPipelineOptions, IngestionSettingsStore, OfficeConversionSettingsStore, PerformanceSettingsService, and backend options.
Environment variables are optional overrides for development/runtime helpers: ONLYRAG_WEB_DEV_SERVER, ONLYRAG_LIBREOFFICE_PATH, ONLYRAG_OCR_PYTHON, ONLYRAG_OCR_BRIDGE, and ONLYRAG_CERT_PASSWORD.
CLI/script arguments are used by PowerShell bootstrap, gate, build, installer, signing, and verification scripts.
Frontend package manifest and web manifest are package.json and src\OnlyRag.Web\public\site.webmanifest; installer manifest is packaging\OnlyRag.iss.
last_completed_work: Completed OnlyRag asset kit integration by regenerating brand assets, adding app icon source/ICO to the generated asset manifest, documenting the refreshed inventory, validating referenced asset paths and dimensions, and making installer wizard artwork explicit in the installer build script.
